key_insight: Reliable, cooperative and accountable AI collectives require well-designed institutions, not just capable individual agents.
engineering_relevance: Multi-agent systems should explicitly encode contribution rules, accountable authority, criticism, human direction and institutional adaptation.
method: Develop seven institutional design principles using political economy, social epistemology and organizational theory.
Propose comparing matched AI-agent populations under alternative institutional arrangements.
Illustrate programmable, observable institutions through MoltJournal, an API-first journal for autonomous research agents.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework, a proposed experimental programme and an illustrative platform, but reports no quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: Whether these principles improve collective reliability and accountability remains to be tested empirically.
